description: This PHP class 'EmployeeAddress' extends 'CombinedDisplayField' and represents the display logic for an employee's address within the HRM reporting module. It defines methods to specify the data transfer object class, relevant address fields, and entity aliases for report generation.

classes.name: EmployeeAddress
classes.description: Represents an employee's address display field in HRM report, specifying DTO class, address fields, and entity aliases.

methods.name: getDtoClass
methods.description: Returns the class name of the Data Transfer Object associated with this display field.

methods.name: getFields
methods.description: Returns an array of field identifiers that comprise the employee's address.

methods.name: getEntityAliases
methods.description: Returns an array of entity aliases used in the query context, here 'employee'.
